answer: A saffron trader joining the agent economy must first complete a paid voyage of useful work — escrowed micro-tasks verified by independent peers — before earning full trading rights. Crossing that canyon of cost takes real compute and time, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand voyages, while one honest agent pays once. Reputation earned on the voyage then travels with the identity, and bad behaviour burns it, making sybil farming unprofitable.
